conventions: The refrain בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם (vv.10-12) reads the asseverative כִּי as unrepresented: the ASV writes In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off with no word for it. אֲמִילַם → I will cut ... off keeps off with the verb (rule 44), since cut alone does not write the destroying the hiphil of מוּל writes, and סְבָבוּנִי → compassed me about keeps about with the verb, because it restates the surrounding סָבַב itself writes and adds nothing the Hebrew lacks; both are discontinuous around the object pronoun under rule 25.

יְהוָה לִי (vv.6-7) → Jehovah is on my side: the copula joins the prepositional predicate (rule 49), the fixed phrase on ... side is the לְ's rendering headed on side under rule 24's content-word sentence (competing head on), and my is the suffix's.

יְמִין יְהוָה (vv.15-16) → The right hand of Jehovah heads on right under rule 31, since the ASV never writes a bare hand for יָמִין (that is יָד's word); the competing head hand is named in each note. The supplied The is the construct's under rule 29.

וַיְהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה (v.14, and תְּהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה v.21) → he is become my salvation: הָיָה takes the become frame with its subject pronoun (rules 17, 21); the first לְ is a dative the ASV recasts as the possessive my, which goes to the suffix while the preposition is unrepresented (rule 40); the second לְ is the resultative one, unrepresented beside a written הָיָה (rule 21). v.22 הָיְתָה לְרֹאשׁ פִּנָּה reads the same way.
report: Checked all 25 candidate lemmas; every multi-treatment bucket is the ASV rendering one morpheme differently in context (his/it, unto/of/to/that, in/into/among/upon, For/That/but), not a split.

Cross-verse constructions read end to end and found consistent: the refrain לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ → endureth for on לְ (vv.1-4, 29, as rule 20 itself reads it); סְבָבוּנִי → compassed ... about and אֲמִילַם → cut ... off with the verb (vv.10-12); asseverative כִּי unrepresented (vv.10-12); infinitive absolute → sore (vv.13, 18); יְמִין → The right hand headed on right (vv.15-16); לִי → is on my side headed on side (vv.6-7); dative לְ silenced beside suffix → my and resultative לְ silenced beside הָיָה → become (vv.14, 21, 22); supplied relative which added over an asyndetic clause with a written antecedent (vv.22, 24); expletive It added before an extraposed infinitival subject (vv.8-9).
The seven added units (v5 and set me, v7 my desire, v8/v9 It, v22/v24 which, v23 doing) are each placed the same way wherever the construction recurs; no verse folds a word another verse marks added.

v23 מֵאֵת יְהוָה → Jehovah's three-morpheme fusion reviewed and retained: no English word is spent on the compound preposition apart from the genitive (rules 30, 49), the copula is הָיְתָה's under rule 21, and doing is a supplied noun for the possessive to stand on (rule 40's closing sentence); the note names the competing reading.

BSB disagreements are all convention: asseverative כִּי (vv.10-12) the ASV leaves unwritten, six dative/resultative לְ silenced by the ASV's recasting (rules 21, 40), and two paragogic he in v25 (rule 32). None is an error.
Nothing to promote: the chapter applies existing rules and the corpus agrees with each.
